title: 伊拉斯謨大橋~Erasmus Bridge
focus: 建築造型主導的單塔不對稱斜張橋：彎折鋼塔、背索、開合橋與通車後的斜索雨風振動~An architecture-led single-pylon asymmetric bridge: bent steel pylon, back stays, bascule span and post-opening rain–wind stay vibration
summary: 鹿特丹的伊拉斯謨大橋全長 802 m，以 139 m 高、彎折不對稱的鋼塔支承約 284 m 的斜張主跨，南端另有 89 m 的開合橋；橋面寬 33.8 m，由兩根箱形主梁與每 4.9 m 一道的橫梁組成，承載車道、電車軌道與人行自行車道。本課從背索如何降低塔的彎矩、橋面橫向受力、鋼塔焊接、開合橋配重與電車軌伸縮，到 1996 年通車後的雨風振動觀測、調諧液壓阻尼器、塗裝與開合機械的長期維護。~Rotterdam’s Erasmus Bridge is 802 m long; a bent, asymmetric 139 m steel pylon carries a cable-stayed main span of about 284 m, and an 89 m bascule sits at the south end. The 33.8 m deck, two box spines with cross beams every 4.9 m, carries traffic lanes, tram tracks, footpaths and cycle tracks. The course runs from how back stays cut pylon bending, transverse deck action, pylon welding, bascule counterweighting and tram-rail expansion, to observation of rain–wind vibration after the 1996 opening, tuned hydraulic dampers and long-term care of coatings and bascule machinery.

units.anchor: 139 m 彎折鋼塔~139 m bent steel pylon
units.title: 背索如何降低不對稱塔的彎矩~How back stays cut bending in an asymmetric pylon
units.mechanism: 伊拉斯謨大橋的最初構想受阿拉米略橋啟發，是一座約 150 m 高、沒有背索、以塔身自重與傾斜平衡主跨的混凝土塔。工程可行性檢討後改為 139 m 的鋼塔並加上背索，原因是城市橋梁的活載變化很大：60 t 級卡車與電車只停在主跨某處時，若沒有背索，主跨斜索拉力的變化全部要由塔身彎曲承受，塔底彎矩隨交通劇烈起伏。背索把塔頂連到岸側錨固點，活載造成的水平力增量大部分由背索的軸力平衡，塔主要承受壓力，彎矩與疲勞應力幅都大幅降低。~The Erasmus Bridge concept, inspired by the Alamillo Bridge, began as a concrete pylon about 150 m tall with no back stays, balancing the main span by its own weight and lean. After engineering review it became a 139 m steel pylon with back stays, because urban live load varies greatly: when 60 t trucks or trams stop somewhere on the main span without back stays, the entire change in main-span stay force must be resisted by pylon bending, so the base moment swings sharply with traffic. Back stays tie the pylon head to anchorage on the shore side, balancing most of the live-load horizontal increment by axial force, so the pylon works mainly in compression with much lower bending and fatigue stress ranges.
units.model: 主跨活載 w = 30 kN/m × 284 m = 8,520 kN，合力距塔 142 m。無背索時塔底附加彎矩 M = 8,520×142 ≈ 1,209,800 kN·m（等於塔頂水平力 8,520×142/125 ≈ 9,680 kN 乘以塔高 125 m）；若背索平衡 75% 的水平增量，M 降為約 302,500 kN·m。數值為教學假設。~Main-span live load w = 30 kN/m × 284 m = 8,520 kN acts with its resultant 142 m from the pylon. Without back stays the extra pylon-base moment is M = 8,520×142 ≈ 1,209,800 kN·m (the head force 8,520×142/125 ≈ 9,680 kN times a 125 m pylon height); if back stays balance 75% of the horizontal increment, M falls to about 302,500 kN·m. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以全橋模型比較有無背索、不同背索勁度下的塔底彎矩包絡與疲勞應力幅；成橋後以載重試驗在主跨不同位置停放車輛，量測塔頂位移、背索力增量與塔底應變，與模型比較。~Compare pylon-base moment envelopes and fatigue stress ranges with and without back stays and for different back-stay stiffness in a global model; after completion park vehicles at several main-span positions in a load test and compare measured pylon-head displacement, back-stay force increments and base strains with the model.
units.failure: 若背索勁度不足或錨固點沉陷，塔在交通荷載下的擺動與彎矩增大，塔身焊道承受較大的疲勞應力幅；背索若鬆弛，主跨在重車通過時下撓加大，行車與電車舒適度變差。~Soft back stays or a settling anchorage increase pylon sway and bending under traffic and raise fatigue stress ranges in pylon welds; slack back stays let the main span deflect more under heavy vehicles, degrading ride and tram comfort.
units.misconception: 只要塔身向後傾斜得夠多，就不需要背索也能承受任何活載。~If the pylon leans back far enough, it can take any live load without back stays.
units.practice: 以造型為主的橋梁在概念階段就要做活載與疲勞的初步檢核，並把結構需求（例如背索）回饋給建築師；造型變更須由結構設計者重新簽認塔與錨固的計算。~An architecture-led bridge needs preliminary live-load and fatigue checks at concept stage, feeding structural needs such as back stays back to the architect; any change of form requires the structural designer to re-sign pylon and anchorage calculations.

units.anchor: 4.9 m 間距橫梁~Cross beams at 4.9 m
units.title: 雙主梁、橫梁與電車荷載的橋面~Twin spines, cross beams and tram loads
units.mechanism: 伊拉斯謨大橋的橋面寬 33.8 m，由兩根高 2.25 m、寬 1.25 m 的箱形主梁承擔縱向彎曲與斜索錨固，四線車道與兩條電車軌道位於兩根主梁之間；橫梁每 4.9 m 一道，並向兩側各懸出 6.7 m 支承人行道與自行車道。電車軌道把集中輪載固定在同一位置反覆通過，對軌道下方的橫梁與主梁連接造成高循環疲勞；懸臂部分雖然荷載較小，但彎矩隨懸出長度平方增加，橫梁根部是應力集中的位置。橫梁也把兩根主梁連成整體，提供抗扭能力。~The Erasmus deck is 33.8 m wide, with two box spines 2.25 m deep and 1.25 m wide carrying longitudinal bending and the stay anchorages; four traffic lanes and two tram tracks sit between the spines, and cross beams every 4.9 m cantilever 6.7 m each side to carry footpaths and cycle tracks. Tram tracks put concentrated wheel loads repeatedly on the same line, causing high-cycle fatigue at cross-beam-to-spine connections beneath the rails; the cantilevers carry lighter loads, but moment grows with the square of the overhang, concentrating stress at the cross-beam roots. The cross beams also tie the two spines together for torsional resistance.
units.model: 橫梁分擔寬 4.9 m、面荷載 12 kPa（含電車與鋪面）時 w = 58.8 kN/m，主梁間跨距 20 m 的簡支彎矩 M = wL²/8 = 58.8×20²/8 = 2,940 kN·m；懸臂 6.7 m、面荷載 11 kPa 時 w = 53.9 kN/m，根部 M = wL²/2 ≈ 53.9×6.7²/2 ≈ 1,210 kN·m。荷載與跨距為教學假設。~A cross beam with 4.9 m tributary width and 12 kPa including trams and surfacing carries w = 58.8 kN/m; over a 20 m span between spines the simply supported moment is M = wL²/8 = 58.8×20²/8 = 2,940 kN·m. A 6.7 m cantilever at 11 kPa carries w = 53.9 kN/m with a root moment M = wL²/2 ≈ 53.9×6.7²/2 ≈ 1,210 kN·m. Loads and span are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以局部有限元素模型分析電車軌下方橫梁與主梁接頭的熱點應力，依疲勞細節分類與電車通過次數評估壽命；施工時檢驗橫梁接頭焊道的超音波與磁粒檢測，營運期定期檢查軌道下方的焊趾。~Analyse hot-spot stresses at cross-beam-to-spine joints under the tram rails with local finite-element models and assess life from detail categories and tram passages; inspect cross-beam joint welds by ultrasonic and magnetic-particle testing during construction, and check weld toes under the rails periodically in service.
units.failure: 電車軌下方的橫梁接頭若細部設計不當或焊接缺陷，反覆輪載可能引發疲勞裂縫並沿腹板擴展；軌道支承鬆動則使衝擊放大，加速裂縫成長與噪音。~Poor detailing or weld defects at cross-beam joints beneath the tram rails let repeated wheel loads start fatigue cracks that spread along the web; loose rail fastenings amplify impact, accelerating crack growth and noise.
units.misconception: 人行道懸臂荷載小，所以橫梁根部不需要特別檢查。~Footpath cantilevers carry little load, so cross-beam roots need no special attention.
units.practice: 電車軌道與橋面結構的介面（軌道扣件、減振墊、排水）要由軌道與結構工程師共同設計，並在維護手冊中把軌道下方接頭列為優先疲勞檢查區。~The interface between tram track and deck (fastenings, resilient pads, drainage) should be designed jointly by track and structural engineers, and the maintenance manual should list joints beneath the rails as priority fatigue inspection areas.

units.title: 鋼塔製造：電腦切割、焊接收縮與幾何控制~Pylon fabrication: computer cutting, weld shrinkage and geometry
units.mechanism: 伊拉斯謨大橋的彎折鋼塔由大量形狀各異的鋼板組成，代爾夫特理工大學的研究指出，當時的電腦輔助設計讓鋼板可以直接由電腦切割，使構件無縫拼合。彎折造型讓每一節塔段的角度與斷面都不同，焊接時的熱收縮會讓每節塔段縮短、扭曲，累積起來可能使塔頂偏離設計位置數公分以上。製造廠必須預估焊接收縮並在下料時預留長度，以夾具與焊接順序控制變形，並在工廠預拼裝確認節段介面吻合，現場接頭才能順利對齊。~The bent steel pylon of the Erasmus Bridge is assembled from many differently shaped plates, and a Delft University of Technology study notes that the computer-aided design of the time allowed plates to be cut directly by computer so parts fitted seamlessly. The bent form gives each pylon section a different angle and cross-section, and heat shrinkage during welding shortens and distorts each section; accumulated, this can move the pylon head several centimetres or more from its design position. The fabricator must predict weld shrinkage and add length at cutting, control distortion with jigs and welding sequence, and trial-assemble at the shop to confirm section interfaces match before site joints can align.
units.model: 若每道橫向全滲透對接焊的收縮約 1.5 mm，沿塔高共 40 道，累積縮短約 1.5×40 = 60 mm；若下料時每段預留 1.5 mm，完工高程誤差可降到量測與溫度的不確定度範圍內。每道收縮量與焊道數為教學假設。~If each transverse full-penetration butt weld shrinks about 1.5 mm and there are 40 along the pylon, the accumulated shortening is about 1.5×40 = 60 mm; adding 1.5 mm per section at cutting brings the finished level error within survey and temperature uncertainty. Shrinkage per weld and weld count are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 工廠預拼裝時以三維量測（全站儀或雷射掃描）比對節段介面與設計模型，記錄每節實際長度與角度；焊後以超音波檢測全滲透焊，現場吊裝後在清晨量測塔軸線，依累積誤差調整後續節段。~During shop trial assembly compare section interfaces with the design model by 3D survey (total station or laser scanning) and record each section’s actual length and angle; test full-penetration welds ultrasonically after welding, survey the pylon axis at dawn after each erection and adjust later sections for accumulated error.
units.failure: 若未預留焊接收縮，塔頂高程與斜索錨點位置偏離，斜索長度與索力需大幅調整；焊接順序不當造成的殘餘應力與變形，可能使塔段介面無法對齊，需現場火焰矯正，增加材料受損與疲勞風險。~Without shrinkage allowance, pylon-head level and stay anchor positions drift, forcing large changes in stay length and force; poor welding sequence leaves residual stress and distortion that misalign section interfaces and require flame straightening on site, adding risk of material damage and fatigue.
units.misconception: 電腦切割的鋼板尺寸精確，焊接後的構件尺寸就一定精確。~Because plates are computer-cut accurately, welded parts are automatically accurate.
units.practice: 製造規範應要求焊接程序評定、收縮預估、預拼裝與三維量測報告，並規定節段介面的容許偏差；預拼裝驗收是吊裝前的停留檢查點，由業主代表與製造廠共同簽認。~The fabrication specification should require welding procedure qualification, shrinkage prediction, trial assembly and 3D survey reports and set interface tolerances; trial-assembly acceptance is a hold point before erection, co-signed by the owner’s representative and the fabricator.

units.title: 89 m 開合橋的配重平衡~Counterweighting the 89 m bascule
units.mechanism: 伊拉斯謨大橋南端的 89 m 開合橋被描述為西歐最大、最重的開合橋，讓高桅船隻能通過。開合橋繞耳軸旋轉，橋面葉板的重量對耳軸產生很大的力矩；若完全由油壓缸或機械驅動直接抬起，所需動力與構件尺寸將非常龐大。因此在耳軸後方設配重，使葉板與配重對耳軸的力矩接近平衡，驅動系統只需克服少量不平衡、摩擦、風力與慣性。設計時通常保留一點「葉板端偏重」，讓橋在關閉狀態下穩定壓在支承上，不會被風或車輛振動抬起。~The 89 m bascule at the south end of the Erasmus Bridge is described as the largest and heaviest in Western Europe, letting tall-masted vessels pass. A bascule rotates about trunnions, and the leaf’s weight creates a large moment about them; lifting it directly with hydraulic cylinders or machinery would need enormous power and members. A counterweight behind the trunnions therefore nearly balances the leaf’s moment, so the drive only overcomes a small imbalance, friction, wind and inertia. Designers usually leave the leaf slightly heavy so the closed bridge sits firmly on its supports and is not lifted by wind or traffic vibration.
units.model: 配重平衡 W_c·b = W_l·a。若葉板重 W_l = 10,000 kN、重心距耳軸 a = 40 m，配重力臂 b = 12 m，完全平衡需 W_c = 10,000×40/12 ≈ 33,300 kN；若保留 2% 的葉板端偏重，配重約 32,700 kN。數值為教學假設。~Counterweight balance W_c·b = W_l·a. For a leaf weight W_l = 10,000 kN with its centroid a = 40 m from the trunnion and a counterweight lever b = 12 m, full balance needs W_c = 10,000×40/12 ≈ 33,300 kN; keeping the leaf 2% heavy gives about 32,700 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 完工後以驅動系統的油壓或馬達扭矩在不同開啟角度量測實際不平衡力矩，與設計比較；必要時以可調配重塊修正。耳軸軸承與支承接觸狀態在開合循環中定期檢查，並記錄關閉時的支承反力。~After completion measure the actual imbalance moment at several opening angles from drive pressures or motor torque and compare with design, trimming with adjustable counterweight blocks if needed; inspect trunnion bearings and support contact periodically through opening cycles and record support reactions in the closed position.
units.failure: 鋪面重鋪、加裝設備或積水使葉板變重而未調整配重，不平衡力矩超出驅動能力，開合時間延長或驅動系統過載；若葉板反而過輕，關閉時可能被風掀動，與車道及電車軌接縫錯位。~Resurfacing, added equipment or trapped water that make the leaf heavier without rebalancing push the imbalance beyond drive capacity, slowing operation or overloading the drive; a leaf that is too light may lift in wind when closed, misaligning the road and tram-rail joints.
units.misconception: 開合橋的配重一次設定好就永遠不用調整。~A bascule’s counterweight is set once and never needs adjusting.
units.practice: 任何影響葉板重量的工程（鋪面、欄杆、照明、軌道）都要先計算重量變化並評估配重調整；維護紀錄須保存每次平衡量測結果與配重塊數量。~Any work that changes leaf weight (surfacing, railings, lighting, track) must first calculate the weight change and assess counterweight adjustment; maintenance records keep every balance measurement and counterweight block count.

units.anchor: 斜索張拉順序~Stay stressing sequence
units.title: 鋼塔架設與斜索張拉的幾何控制~Pylon erection and stay-stressing geometry control
units.mechanism: 不對稱的彎折鋼塔在架設完成、尚未掛索時，自重偏心就會讓塔頂偏向一側；掛上主跨斜索並承受橋面重量後，塔頂又被拉向主跨。施工控制的目標是讓塔在成橋恆載下回到設計幾何，因此通常要先讓塔頂帶著預偏量，並按照預先計算的順序分批張拉前索與背索。每一批張拉都會同時改變塔頂位置、橋面高程與已張拉斜索的力量，必須用施工階段分析預測，並以量測確認後才能進行下一批。~An asymmetric bent steel pylon leans to one side under its own eccentric weight before any stays are hung; once main-span stays carry deck weight, the head is pulled toward the main span. Construction control aims to bring the pylon to its design geometry under completed dead load, so the head is usually given a pre-offset and front and back stays are stressed in batches in a pre-computed order. Each batch changes the head position, deck levels and forces in already stressed stays, so it must be predicted by staged analysis and confirmed by measurement before the next.
units.model: 若某批張拉在塔頂造成淨水平力 H = 2,000 kN、塔頂水平勁度 k = 15,000 kN/m，塔頂移動 δ = 2,000/15,000 ≈ 0.133 m；為使成橋時塔軸垂直，可預先讓塔頂向背跨側預偏約 133 mm。數值為教學假設。~If a stressing batch puts a net horizontal force H = 2,000 kN on the pylon head with lateral stiffness k = 15,000 kN/m, the head moves δ = 2,000/15,000 ≈ 0.133 m; to have the pylon axis vertical at completion, the head can be pre-offset about 133 mm toward the back span. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每批張拉前後在清晨量測塔頂座標、橋面高程與各索力（千斤頂油壓與荷重計），與施工階段分析逐步比對；偏差超出容許時先調整下一批的張拉力，而非一次大幅修正。~Before and after each batch survey the pylon-head coordinates and deck levels at dawn and record each stay force from jack pressures and load cells, comparing step by step with the staged analysis; when out of tolerance, adjust the next batch rather than making one large correction.
units.failure: 若張拉順序錯誤或一次張拉過多，塔頂偏移超出塔的彎曲容量，鋼塔可能局部挫屈或接頭受損；量測受日照影響而未修正，會導致錯誤的索力調整，完工後塔軸與橋面線形都偏離設計。~A wrong order or too much force in one batch can push the head beyond the pylon’s bending capacity, causing local buckling or joint damage; uncorrected solar effects in surveys lead to wrong force adjustments, leaving pylon axis and deck profile off design at completion.
units.misconception: 斜索只要最後一次全部張拉到設計索力，順序並不重要。~As long as all stays reach design force at the end, the stressing order does not matter.
units.practice: 張拉計畫要列出每批的索號、目標力、預期塔頂位移與橋面高程，以及容許偏差與停止條件；張拉作業由施工控制工程師在場確認量測後才可放行下一批。~The stressing plan should list each batch’s stay numbers, target forces, expected pylon-head displacement and deck levels, with tolerances and stop criteria; the construction-control engineer confirms measurements on site before releasing the next batch.

units.anchor: 開合橋與斜張段接縫~Bascule-to-cable-stayed joint
units.title: 斜張段與開合橋的介面：溫度伸縮與電車軌~The cable-stayed to bascule interface: thermal movement and tram rails
units.mechanism: 斜張段的鋼橋面隨溫度伸縮，開合橋葉板則必須在每次關閉時準確落回原位，兩者之間的介面同時要容許伸縮、讓車輛平順通過，還要讓電車軌道連續。一般伸縮縫只需處理路面，但電車軌是連續鋼軌，跨越伸縮縫或開合縫時需要軌道伸縮調節器或可分離的軌道接頭，且軌頂高差必須控制在毫米級，否則電車通過時產生衝擊與脫軌風險。介面處的支承、伸縮縫、軌道接頭與鎖定裝置因此必須作為一個系統設計與調整。~The steel deck of the cable-stayed part expands and contracts with temperature, while the bascule leaf must return precisely to position each time it closes; the interface between them must allow movement, give vehicles a smooth ride and keep tram rails continuous. An ordinary expansion joint deals only with the road surface, but tram rails are continuous steel, so crossing an expansion or opening gap needs rail expansion devices or separable rail joints with rail-head steps controlled to millimetres, or trams suffer impact and derailment risk. Bearings, joints, rail joints and locking devices at the interface must therefore be designed and adjusted as one system.
units.model: 斜張段自固定點到開合橋接縫的長度 L = 300 m、鋼 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C、年溫差 ΔT = 40 °C：ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×300×40 = 0.144 m，即約 144 mm，軌道伸縮調節器的行程必須涵蓋此值並加上施工誤差與支承位移。數值為教學假設。~With L = 300 m from the fixed point of the cable-stayed part to the bascule joint, steel α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C and an annual range ΔT = 40 °C, ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×300×40 = 0.144 m, about 144 mm; the rail expansion device must cover this plus construction tolerance and bearing movement. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以不同季節量測接縫開口與溫度的關係，確認在設計行程內；開合橋每次關閉後檢查鎖定裝置就位與軌頂高差，並以軌道幾何量測車定期檢測；電車通過時量測接縫處的衝擊加速度。~Measure joint opening against temperature across seasons to confirm it stays within design travel; after each bascule closure check that locks are engaged and rail-head steps are within limits, survey track geometry periodically with a recording vehicle and measure impact accelerations at the joint as trams pass.
units.failure: 伸縮行程不足時，夏季接縫擠死、冬季拉開過大，軌道調節器損壞；開合橋關閉位置偏差使軌頂高差超限，電車衝擊增加，長期造成軌道與支承損壞，甚至需暫停電車服務。~Insufficient travel jams the joint in summer and overopens it in winter, damaging rail expansion devices; a bascule that closes slightly off position leaves rail steps beyond limits, increasing tram impact and, over time, damaging track and bearings or forcing tram suspension.
units.misconception: 電車軌道可以像路面一樣直接跨過伸縮縫，不需要特別裝置。~Tram rails can cross an expansion joint like the road surface without special devices.
units.practice: 介面設計要由結構、機械、軌道與交通營運單位共同簽認，並訂出開合橋關閉後放行電車前的檢查清單（鎖定、軌頂高差、號誌連鎖）。~The interface design needs joint sign-off by structural, mechanical, track and transit operators, with a checklist before trams are released after each closure covering locks, rail steps and signal interlocking.

units.anchor: 主跨斜索振動紀錄~Main-span stay vibration records
units.title: 1996 年通車後的雨風振動觀測~Observing rain–wind vibration after the 1996 opening
units.mechanism: 伊拉斯謨大橋 1996 年 10 月開放交通後不久，就被觀察到在強風中擺動，隨後主跨斜索出現大振幅的氣動不穩定，被確認為雨風共同作用的振動：雨水在斜索表面形成沿索流下的水線，改變斷面形狀與氣流分離，使原本穩定的圓形斷面在特定風速與風向下吸收能量。代爾夫特理工大學的研究也提到大橋早期在雨、風與結構共同作用下出現擺動並短暫封閉。觀測這類振動要同時記錄斜索加速度、風速風向與降雨，因為只有三者同時符合條件時才會發生。~Soon after opening to traffic in October 1996, the Erasmus Bridge was seen to sway in strong wind, and the main-span stays then showed large-amplitude aerodynamic instability identified as rain–wind-induced vibration: rainwater forms rivulets running down the stay surface, changing the effective section and flow separation so that a normally stable circular section absorbs energy at certain wind speeds and directions. A Delft University of Technology study also notes that the bridge swayed under the combination of rain, wind and its structure early on and was briefly closed. Observing such vibration requires simultaneous records of stay acceleration, wind speed and direction and rainfall, because it occurs only when all three conditions coincide.
units.model: 簡諧振動加速度 a = (2πf)²·A。若某索以 f = 1.2 Hz、振幅 A = 0.3 m 振動，a = (2π×1.2)²×0.3 ≈ 56.8×0.3 ≈ 17.1 m/s²，約 1.74 g；加速度計量程至少需 2 g，取樣率宜高於 20 Hz。頻率與振幅為教學假設。~Harmonic acceleration a = (2πf)²·A. A stay vibrating at f = 1.2 Hz with A = 0.3 m reaches a = (2π×1.2)²×0.3 ≈ 56.8×0.3 ≈ 17.1 m/s², about 1.74 g, so accelerometers need at least a 2 g range and sampling above about 20 Hz. Frequency and amplitude are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在數根代表性斜索上裝設雙軸加速度計，同步記錄橋上風速計與雨量計，以事件觸發方式保存高解析資料；分析振幅與風速、風向、降雨強度的關係，辨識發生區間，並以影片輔助確認振型。~Fit biaxial accelerometers on several representative stays with synchronised deck anemometers and rain gauges, storing high-resolution data on event triggers; analyse amplitude against wind speed, direction and rainfall intensity to identify the onset envelope, and confirm mode shapes with video.
units.failure: 若只量測風速而沒有降雨紀錄，可能誤判為一般渦振或抖振，選錯對策；若量測位置只在一根索，無法判斷是個別索的問題還是普遍現象，阻尼器的配置也會失準。~Measuring wind without rainfall can misclassify the motion as ordinary vortex shedding or buffeting and lead to the wrong remedy; measuring only one stay cannot tell an individual problem from a general one, misdirecting damper deployment.
units.misconception: 斜索振動只會在颱風等級的強風中發生。~Stay vibration only happens in typhoon-strength winds.
units.practice: 新斜張橋通車初期應保留臨時監測，至少涵蓋一個完整的風雨季；發現大振幅時立即啟動臨時措施（例如臨時連索）並保存資料，作為永久對策的設計依據。~Keep temporary monitoring on a new cable-stayed bridge for at least one full wind-and-rain season after opening; when large amplitudes appear, apply temporary measures such as temporary ties at once and preserve the data as the design basis for permanent measures.

units.anchor: 永久液壓阻尼器~Permanent hydraulic dampers
units.title: 調諧液壓阻尼器的選型與驗收~Selecting and accepting tuned hydraulic dampers
units.mechanism: 伊拉斯謨大橋在臨時措施之後約一年，為主跨斜索加裝了永久的調諧液壓阻尼器。阻尼器連接斜索與橋面，裝在靠近錨點的位置；斜索振動時阻尼器的活塞往復運動，把能量轉成熱。阻尼器係數必須「調諧」：太小時活塞幾乎不受阻、消能少；太大時阻尼器像固定點，斜索在阻尼器處形成新的節點，振動照樣發生。最佳係數取決於索力、索的單位質量、阻尼器位置與目標模態，因此每一組索可能需要不同的設定。~About a year after the temporary measures, permanent tuned hydraulic dampers were fitted to the main-span stays of the Erasmus Bridge. A damper links the stay to the deck near the anchorage; as the stay vibrates, the piston moves back and forth and converts energy into heat. The damping coefficient must be tuned: too low and the piston moves almost freely and dissipates little; too high and the damper acts like a fixed point, creating a new node so vibration continues. The optimum depends on stay force, mass per metre, damper position and target mode, so different stay groups may need different settings.
units.model: 張緊弦的最佳阻尼係數 c_opt ≈ √(T·m)/(n·π·x_d/L)。取 T = 3,000 kN、m = 60 kg/m、第 1 模態、x_d/L = 0.02：√(3×10⁶×60) ≈ 13,416 N·s/m，c_opt ≈ 13,416/(π×0.02) ≈ 213,500 N·s/m，此時最大附加阻尼比約 x_d/(2L) = 1.0%。數值為教學假設。~For a taut cable the optimum damper coefficient is c_opt ≈ √(T·m)/(n·π·x_d/L). With T = 3,000 kN, m = 60 kg/m, mode 1 and x_d/L = 0.02, √(3×10⁶×60) ≈ 13,416 N·s/m and c_opt ≈ 13,416/(π×0.02) ≈ 213,500 N·s/m, giving a maximum added damping ratio of about x_d/(2L) = 1.0%. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 阻尼器出廠前做力—速度與溫度試驗，確認係數在規格容差內；安裝後以人工拉索激振並釋放，記錄自由衰減，計算附加阻尼比，與目標比較；再以下一個風雨季的監測資料確認振幅已受控制。~Before delivery test dampers for force–velocity and temperature behaviour to confirm the coefficient is within tolerance; after installation excite a stay by hand, release it and record free decay to compute added damping against the target; then confirm controlled amplitudes with monitoring data from the next wind-and-rain season.
units.failure: 阻尼器係數設定錯誤或支架剛度不足，阻尼器變成無效或成為節點，斜索在風雨中仍大幅振動；阻尼器漏油、銷接磨耗則在幾年內逐漸失效，若無定期檢查，振動問題會再度出現。~A wrong coefficient or a flexible bracket makes the damper ineffective or turns it into a node, so the stay still vibrates heavily in wind and rain; oil leaks and pin wear degrade dampers over a few years, and without periodic checks the vibration returns.
units.misconception: 阻尼器的阻尼係數越大，斜索的減振效果就越好。~The larger the damper coefficient, the better the stay is damped.
units.practice: 阻尼器規格書要寫明目標模態、係數與容差、溫度範圍、行程與耐久循環，並規定安裝後的衰減試驗與每年檢查；各索的阻尼器設定值要列入交接文件。~The damper specification should state target mode, coefficient and tolerance, temperature range, stroke and endurance cycles and require post-installation decay tests and annual inspection; each stay’s damper setting belongs in the handover documents.

units.anchor: 淺藍色鋼結構塗裝~Light-blue steel coating
units.title: 河港環境下鋼塔與鋼橋面的防蝕維護~Corrosion maintenance of steel pylon and deck in a river port
units.mechanism: 伊拉斯謨大橋以淺藍色鋼塔為城市地標，鋼塔、主梁與橫梁都依賴塗裝系統防止腐蝕。馬斯河港區的潮濕空氣、工業與交通排放，以及冬季除冰鹽，會逐年消耗塗層；塗層劣化通常從邊角、焊道、螺栓與排水不良處開始。塗裝維護的經濟性取決於時機：在塗層仍完整、只需補塗面漆時處理，成本與交通影響都遠小於等到底漆失效、鋼材生鏽後全面噴砂重塗。地標橋的顏色與外觀也是業主要維持的價值，維護計畫需同時考慮防蝕與外觀。~The light-blue steel pylon is a city landmark, and the pylon, spines and cross beams all depend on coating systems against corrosion. Humid air in the Maas port area, industrial and traffic emissions and winter de-icing salt consume the coating year by year, with breakdown usually starting at edges, welds, bolts and poorly drained spots. The economics of coating maintenance depend on timing: overcoating while the system is still intact costs far less, and disrupts traffic far less, than full blast-cleaning and recoating after the primer fails and steel rusts. The colour and appearance of a landmark bridge are also values the owner must keep, so maintenance plans address both corrosion and appearance.
units.model: 若塗層初始乾膜厚 320 μm、需維持的最低有效厚度 160 μm、平均消耗速率 6 μm/年，到達補塗時點約 (320 − 160)/6 ≈ 26.7 年；若邊角與焊道處消耗速率為 12 μm/年，則約 13.3 年就需局部補塗。數值為教學假設。~With an initial dry film of 320 μm, a minimum effective thickness of 160 μm and mean consumption of 6 μm a year, overcoating is due after about (320 − 160)/6 ≈ 26.7 years; where edges and welds consume 12 μm a year, local touch-up is needed after about 13.3 years. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 定期以乾膜厚度計抽測代表區域，並依標準的生鏽與起泡等級圖評定塗層狀態；邊角、焊道與排水孔附近列為重點檢查點，以照片與位置編號建立劣化歷程，作為選擇局部補塗或全面重塗的依據。~Periodically sample dry-film thickness in representative areas and rate coating condition against standard rust and blistering scales; prioritise edges, welds and drain holes, building a deterioration history with photographs and location numbers to choose between local touch-up and full recoating.
units.failure: 若等到大面積生鏽才處理，必須全面噴砂重塗，工程需要大型圍封與長時間交通管制；局部積水或排水孔堵塞造成的腐蝕若未及時發現，可能在主梁或橫梁接頭處削弱斷面。~Waiting for widespread rust forces full blast-cleaning and recoating with large enclosures and long traffic restrictions; corrosion from ponding or blocked drains, if not caught early, can reduce sections at spine or cross-beam joints.
units.misconception: 鋼橋重新油漆主要是為了好看，對結構壽命影響不大。~Repainting a steel bridge is mainly cosmetic and hardly affects structural life.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含塗裝系統規格、顏色編號、原始膜厚紀錄與相容的補塗材料；維護計畫要訂出排水孔清理週期與塗層檢查週期，並在重塗時評估封閉施工對電車與交通的影響。~Handover should include the coating specification, colour reference, original film-thickness records and compatible touch-up materials; the maintenance plan should set drain-cleaning and coating-inspection intervals and assess tram and traffic impacts of enclosed recoating.

units.title: 開合橋機電、運轉紀錄與營運交接~Bascule machinery, operating records and handover
units.mechanism: 開合橋的耳軸、油壓缸、鎖定裝置、煞車與控制系統，是伊拉斯謨大橋除了斜張結構之外的另一個關鍵系統。每次開合都讓耳軸軸承與驅動元件承受一次荷載循環，數十年下來的循環數足以構成疲勞與磨耗問題；控制系統還要與號誌、電車與船舶交通連鎖，確保開合時橋上無車。代爾夫特理工大學的研究也記錄了 2009 至 2010 年冬季冰柱形成、大橋封閉數日的事件，說明營運單位必須同時處理機械、結構與天候風險。完整的運轉紀錄是判斷何時檢修或更換元件的依據。~The bascule’s trunnions, hydraulic cylinders, locks, brakes and controls form a second critical system beside the cable-stayed structure. Each opening applies one load cycle to trunnion bearings and drive components, and over decades the count becomes a fatigue and wear issue; the controls must also interlock with signals, trams and shipping so no vehicle is on the leaf when it moves. A Delft University of Technology study also records icicles forming in the winter of 2009 to 2010 and the bridge closing for several days, showing that the operator must manage mechanical, structural and weather risks together. Complete operating records are the basis for deciding when to overhaul or replace components.
units.model: 若平均每天開合 6 次，30 年累積 6×365×30 = 65,700 次；耳軸與油壓元件的設計循環數若取 200,000 次，30 年使用約 33%；若開合頻率加倍為每天 12 次，則約 66%。開合頻率與設計循環數為教學假設。~At an average of 6 openings a day, 30 years accumulate 6×365×30 = 65,700 cycles; against a design life of 200,000 cycles for trunnions and hydraulics, that uses about 33%; doubling to 12 openings a day uses about 66%. Opening frequency and design cycles are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 控制系統自動記錄每次開合的時間、角度、油壓、馬達電流與異常訊息；定期檢查耳軸軸承間隙、油品分析、鎖定裝置作動與連鎖測試，並把循環數與設計值比較，接近門檻時安排大修。~Have the control system log every opening’s time, angle, hydraulic pressure, motor current and alarms; periodically check trunnion bearing clearance, analyse oil, test locks and interlocks, and compare accumulated cycles with design values, scheduling overhaul as thresholds approach.
units.failure: 連鎖系統失效時，開合橋可能在電車或車輛仍在橋上時啟動，造成嚴重事故；耳軸軸承磨耗未被發現，可能使葉板關閉位置偏差，影響路面與軌道接縫，甚至卡在開啟狀態中斷交通。~A failed interlock could start the leaf with a tram or vehicles still on it, causing a serious accident; undetected trunnion wear can misplace the closed leaf, affecting road and rail joints or even jamming it open and cutting traffic.
units.misconception: 開合橋的機械只要能動就沒問題，不需要記錄每次運轉的資料。~As long as bascule machinery works, there is no need to log each operation.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含機電圖說、連鎖邏輯、操作程序、緊急手動操作方法、備品清單與運轉紀錄格式；任何控制邏輯修改都要經安全評估並在開放前做完整連鎖測試。~Handover should include mechanical and electrical drawings, interlock logic, operating procedures, emergency manual operation, spares list and log format; any change to control logic requires a safety assessment and a full interlock test before reopening.

example: 設計練習：估算加裝阻尼器後，雨風振動中斜索振幅的變化量級。設某主跨斜索 T = 3,000 kN、m = 60 kg/m、L = 250 m，第一頻率 f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m) = (1/500)×√(50,000) ≈ 0.447 Hz。原始阻尼比 ζ₀ = 0.2%，在某風雨條件下每週期輸入的能量使振幅穩定在 A₀ = 0.30 m。若氣動輸入近似為負阻尼 ζ_a = −0.15%，淨阻尼 0.05% 時振幅受非線性限制停在 0.30 m；加裝 x_d/L = 0.02 的最佳阻尼器後，附加阻尼約 1.0%，淨阻尼 ζ = 0.2% + 1.0% − 0.15% = 1.05% 為正，振動不再成長而衰減。以對數遞減 δ = 2πζ ≈ 0.066 計，振幅從 0.30 m 衰減到 0.03 m 需要 ln(10)/0.066 ≈ 35 個週期，以第 3 模態約 1.34 Hz 計約 26 秒。若阻尼器只能裝在 x_d/L = 0.01，附加阻尼約 0.5%，淨阻尼 0.55%，衰減到同樣振幅約需 67 個週期。數值為教學假設，不代表本橋實測。~Design exercise: estimate how damper retrofit changes stay amplitude under rain–wind excitation. A main-span stay has T = 3,000 kN, m = 60 kg/m and L = 250 m, so f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m) = (1/500)×√(50,000) ≈ 0.447 Hz. With inherent damping ζ₀ = 0.2%, a wind–rain condition feeds enough energy to hold amplitude at A₀ = 0.30 m. Treating the aerodynamic input as negative damping ζ_a = −0.15%, the small net value lets nonlinear effects cap the motion at 0.30 m; adding an optimal damper at x_d/L = 0.02 gives about 1.0% added damping, so net ζ = 0.2% + 1.0% − 0.15% = 1.05% is positive and motion decays instead of growing. With logarithmic decrement δ = 2πζ ≈ 0.066, decaying from 0.30 m to 0.03 m takes ln(10)/0.066 ≈ 35 cycles, about 26 seconds in mode 3 at about 1.34 Hz. If the damper can only sit at x_d/L = 0.01, added damping is about 0.5%, net 0.55%, and the same decay takes about 67 cycles. Values are teaching assumptions, not measurements on this bridge.
history: 伊拉斯謨大橋為連接鹿特丹市中心與南岸新開發的 Kop van Zuid 而建，主要目標是成為城市地標。建築師 Ben van Berkel 在 1990 年提出受阿拉米略橋啟發的構想，經工程可行性修改為 139 m 鋼塔加背索，市議會於 1991 年 11 月確定塔形；大部分經費來自荷蘭經濟結構強化基金。工程於 1993 年 9 月 1 日開工，1996 年 9 月由女王碧雅翠絲正式啟用，工期約 3 年又 3 天、實際成本略低於預算。通車後的雨風振動與後來加裝的調諧液壓阻尼器，使它成為斜索防振的重要案例。本課只重建公開工程原理，不代表任何設計文件。~The Erasmus Bridge was built to link central Rotterdam with the newly developed Kop van Zuid on the south bank, primarily as a city landmark. Architect Ben van Berkel proposed an Alamillo-inspired concept in 1990, which engineering feasibility reworked into a 139 m steel pylon with back stays, and the city council fixed the pylon form in November 1991; most funding came from the Dutch economic structure fund. Construction began on 1 September 1993 and Queen Beatrix opened the bridge in September 1996, about 3 years and 3 days later, with realised cost slightly below budget. Rain–wind vibration after opening and the tuned hydraulic dampers fitted later made it a key case in stay vibration control. This course reconstructs public engineering principles only and represents no design document.
facts: 全長 802 m，斜張主跨約 284 m~Total length 802 m with a cable-stayed main span of about 284 m
不對稱彎折鋼塔高約 139 m（原構想約 150 m 混凝土塔）~The asymmetric bent steel pylon is about 139 m tall (the concept was a concrete pylon of about 150 m)
南端開合橋長 89 m，為西歐最大最重的開合橋~The south bascule is 89 m long, the largest and heaviest in Western Europe
橋面寬 33.8 m，通航淨空約 12.5 m~The deck is 33.8 m wide with about 12.5 m navigation clearance
兩根箱形主梁高 2.25 m、寬 1.25 m，橫梁間距 4.9 m、懸臂 6.7 m~Two box spines are 2.25 m deep and 1.25 m wide, with cross beams every 4.9 m cantilevering 6.7 m
公開導覽資料列出前索 32 根、背索 8 根~Public guide material lists 32 front stays and 8 back stays
1993 年 9 月 1 日開工，約 3 年 3 天後於 1996 年 9 月啟用~Construction began on 1 September 1993 and the bridge opened about 3 years and 3 days later in September 1996
預算 3.65 億荷蘭盾（1991 年幣值），實際約 3.62 億荷蘭盾（1996 年幣值）~The budget was 365 million guilders at 1991 prices, with about 362 million spent at 1996 prices

timeline.event: Ben van Berkel 提出受阿拉米略橋啟發的設計構想~Ben van Berkel proposes a design concept inspired by the Alamillo Bridge
11 月市議會確定 139 m 鋼塔加背索的最終塔形~In November the city council fixes the final 139 m steel pylon with back stays
9 月 1 日開工，並在三年多後如期完工~Construction begins on 1 September and finishes on schedule just over three years later
9 月正式啟用，10 月開放交通後出現斜索雨風振動~Officially opened in September; rain–wind stay vibration appears after traffic starts in October
臨時措施後約一年，主跨斜索加裝永久調諧液壓阻尼器~About a year after temporary measures, permanent tuned hydraulic dampers are fitted to main-span stays
